name: Cordell
source:
A teacher at Piova music school, she is also a personal lecturer for Chris and Asino.

Cordell is very strict but also has a gentle, caring side. At school she is among one of the highest rated teachers and many students like her.

[From [url=http://www.zomgforums.com/visual-novels/19796-vn-symphonic-rain-review.html]Review by Ruwi[/url]]
